map.为什么 Base32 末尾有等号填充？: Why does Base32 end with equals-sign padding?
map.Base32 每 5 字节（40 位）切成 8 个 5 位组；原文长度不是 5: Base32 splits every 5 bytes (40 bits) into 8 groups of 5 bits. When the input length is not a multiple of 5, the final group has fewer than 5 bits, so it is zero-padded and filled with = up to 8 characters (adding 1, 3, 4, or 6 equals signs). Removing the padding does not break decoding, but it must be restored according to RFC 4648.
